en-US.name: KaloCalc
en-US.subtitle: Snap meals, count calories
en-US.promotionalText: Photograph your meal, scan a barcode or search a food, and see calories and macros against your own daily goal.
en-US.description:
KaloCalc is a simple calorie and nutrition diary.

LOG FOOD YOUR WAY
• Search foods from Open Food Facts and pick a portion.
• Scan a barcode.
• Photograph a meal. On-device recognition suggests the food; with your own free Google Gemini API key the app estimates the dishes, portions and calories.
• Edit any estimate: change grams or ingredients and the totals update.
• Build a meal from ingredients with household measures such as spoons and cups.
• Save favourites and add them again with one tap.

KNOW YOUR TARGET
• Calorie calculator from your age, height, weight and activity.
• Goals: lose, maintain or gain, with saved goals and macro targets for protein, carbs and fat.
• A day's progress against its target, by meal.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Weight log with a chart.
• Calories for the last 7 days against your goal.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything is stored on your phone. There is no account and no sign-up.
• Your Gemini key stays in the iOS Keychain. Photos and search text are sent to Google only if you set a key and agree to it.

Available in English, Bulgarian, German, French and Spanish.

Estimates are approximate and are not medical advice.
